Bigwing Unique Phone Campaign Pairs: =MAP(H21:H, LAMBDA(d, IF(d="", "", IFERROR(COUNTUNIQUE(FILTER(phoneCol&"|"&campaignCol, dateCol=d, brandCol="bigwing", phoneCol<>"", campaignCol<>"")), 0))))
Redwing Unique Phone Campaign Pairs: =MAP(H21:H, LAMBDA(d, IF(d="", "", IFERROR(COUNTUNIQUE(FILTER(phoneCol&"|"&campaignCol, dateCol=d, brandCol="redwing", phoneCol<>"", campaignCol<>"")), 0))))
Bigwing Instagram Leads: =MAP(H21:H, LAMBDA(d, IF(d="", "", COUNTIFS(dateCol, d, brandCol, "bigwing", platformCol, "ig"))))
Bigwing Facebook Leads: =MAP(H21:H, LAMBDA(d, IF(d="", "", COUNTIFS(dateCol, d, brandCol, "bigwing", platformCol, "fb"))))
Redwing Instagram Leads: =MAP(H21:H, LAMBDA(d, IF(d="", "", COUNTIFS(dateCol, d, brandCol, "redwing", platformCol, "ig"))))
Redwing Facebook Leads: =MAP(H21:H, LAMBDA(d, IF(d="", "", COUNTIFS(dateCol, d, brandCol, "redwing", platformCol, "fb"))))
Hourly Breakdown: =MAP(H21:H, LAMBDA(d, IF(d="", "", TEXTJOIN("|", TRUE, MAP(SEQUENCE(24, 1, 0, 1), LAMBDA(h, TEXT(h, "00")&"="&COUNTIFS(dateCol, d, hourCol, h)&","&COUNTIFS(dateCol, d, brandCol, "bigwing", hourCol, h)&","&COUNTIFS(dateCol, d, brandCol, "redwing", hourCol, h)))))))
Campaign Counts: =MAP(H21:H, LAMBDA(d, IF(d="", "", IFERROR(LET(c, SORT(UNIQUE(FILTER(campaignCol, dateCol=d, campaignCol<>""))), TEXTJOIN("|", TRUE, MAP(c, LAMBDA(x, x&"::"&COUNTIFS(dateCol, d, campaignCol, x))))), ""))))
Bigwing Response Counts: =MAP(H21:H, LAMBDA(d, IF(d="", "", TEXTJOIN("|", TRUE, MAP({"yes";"no"}, LAMBDA(x, x&"::"&COUNTIFS(dateCol, d, brandCol, "bigwing", locationCol, x)))))))
Redwing Location Counts: =MAP(H21:H, LAMBDA(d, IF(d="", "", IFERROR(LET(loc, SORT(UNIQUE(FILTER(locationCol, dateCol=d, brandCol="redwing", locationCol<>""))), TEXTJOIN("|", TRUE, MAP(loc, LAMBDA(x, x&"::"&COUNTIFS(dateCol, d, brandCol, "redwing", locationCol, x))))), ""))))
